title: Silver(I) complexes with N-methylphenothiazine as potential antimicrobial agents with a multi-target mode of action.
authors: Andrejevic, Tina P; Brankovic, Jovica; Ilic-Tomic, Tatjana; Stevanovic, Nevena; Pantovic, Bojana; Asanin, Darko P; Nikodinovic-Runic, Jasmina; Petrovic, Vladimir P; Markovic, Violeta R; Glisic, Biljana D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究银配合物的抗菌活性及其与ct-DNA小沟结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、分子对接为辅，与课题核心匹配度有限。
abstract: N-Methylphenothiazine (N-Mephtz) was used as a ligand for the synthesis of three new silver(I) complexes with the general formula [Ag(N-Mephtz)(4)]X.nH(2)O (X is CF(3)SO(3)(-) and n = 1/3 for 1, X is SbF(6)(-) and n = 0 for 2, and X is PF(6)(-) and n = 0 for 3). These complexes were characterized using spectroscopic methods, while their structures were determined by single crystal X-ray diffraction analysis. In all complexes, four N-Mephtz ligands are monodentately coordinated to the silver(I) ion through the sulfur atom, forming cationic [Ag(N-Mephtz)(4)](+) species, with CF(3)SO(3)(-), SbF(6)(-) and PF(6)(-) acting as counterions for 1-3, respectively. Experimental IR band assignments were supported by DFT calculations, and TD-DFT simulations provided insight into their UV-Vis spectra. The antimicrobial activity of complexes 1-3 was evaluated against different bacterial strains and one fungal strain, with complex 1 exhibiting notable activity against all tested microorganisms, with MIC values ranging from 8 to 30 microg mL(-1) (7.17 to 26.88 microM). Molecular docking screening identified eight potential antimicrobial protein targets among the tested microorganisms. Cytotoxicity assessments revealed pronounced effects on human lung cancer (A549) and colon cancer (HCT116) cell lines, suggesting potential antiproliferative activity. However, the observed cytotoxicity toward mammalian cells also indicates the need for further structural refinement to improve selectivity for antimicrobial applications. The interactions of the complexes with calf thymus DNA (ct-DNA) and bovine serum albumin (BSA) were examined to assess their biomolecular binding affinities. The binding constant (K(A)) indicated that complexes 1 and 3 have a similar binding affinity to this protein as N-Mephtz, while complex 2 demonstrated a lower affinity. All complexes exhibited significantly enhanced ct-DNA binding via the minor groove compared to the free ligand. Molecular docking confirmed strong minor groove DNA interactions and identified favorable BSA binding sites.
abstract_zh: N-甲基吩噻嗪（N-Mephtz）被用作配体，合成了三种新的银(I)配合物，其通式为[Ag(N-Mephtz)(4)]X.nH(2)O（其中X为CF(3)SO(3)(-)，n=1/3对应配合物1；X为SbF(6)(-)，n=0对应配合物2；X为PF(6)(-)，n=0对应配合物3）。这些配合物通过光谱方法进行了表征，其结构通过单晶X射线衍射分析确定。在所有配合物中，四个N-Mephtz配体通过硫原子以单齿方式配位至银(I)离子，形成阳离子[Ag(N-Mephtz)(4)](+)物种，CF(3)SO(3)(-)、SbF(6)(-)和PF(6)(-)分别作为配合物1-3的反离子。实验红外波段归属得到了DFT计算的支持，TD-DFT模拟为其紫外-可见光谱提供了见解。配合物1-3的抗菌活性针对不同细菌菌株和一种真菌菌株进行了评估，其中配合物1对所有测试微生物表现出显著活性，MIC值范围为8至30微克每毫升（7.17至26.88微摩尔）。分子对接筛选在测试微生物中识别出八个潜在的抗菌蛋白靶点。细胞毒性评估显示对人肺癌（A549）和结肠癌（HCT116）细胞系具有显著影响，提示潜在的抗增殖活性。然而，对哺乳动物细胞观察到的细胞毒性也表明需要进一步的结构优化以提高抗菌应用的选择性。研究了配合物与小牛胸腺DNA（ct-DNA）和牛血清白蛋白（BSA）的相互作用，以评估其生物分子结合亲和力。结合常数（K(A)）表明，配合物1和3对该蛋白的结合亲和力与N-Mephtz相似，而配合物2表现出较低的亲和力。所有配合物通过小沟与ct-DNA的结合均显著增强，相较于游离配体。分子对接确认了强的小沟DNA相互作用，并识别出有利的BSA结合位点。
